ui_bugs.issue: ErrorBoundary triggers on tab open: `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'printFilter' before initialization`. Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ) violation — the `dateFilteredItems` useMemo at line 379 reads `printFilter` at lines 386/390 BEFORE its `useState` declaration at line 740. Same class of bug as the advancingId regression: an F4.3 state hook was placed after the code that consumes it. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shipments.tsx:379-391 (consumer) and :740 (declaration).

integration_issues.issue: Login and dashboard render fine, but tapping the Shipments tab (a[href*="shipments"]) immediately renders the ErrorBoundary red screen. All F4.3 UI (date-filter row, Print status filter chips, Print Now / Printed buttons) is unreachable.

action_items: Fix TDZ: move `const [printFilter, setPrintFilter] = useState<"All" | "Printed" | "Not Printed">("All")` from line 740 of /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shipments.tsx UP to before the `dateFilteredItems` useMemo (before line 379). Ideally, co-locate all Phase F4.3 useState hooks (advancingId, pendingPrintConfirmId, printFilter) at the very top of the component body, right after the other top-level useStates, so future refactors can't reintroduce this class of bug.
Suggest also moving the F4.3 comment block that currently sits at line 727-740 together with the state declarations so intent is preserved.
After the fix, re-run this same smoke test (login → tap Shipments tab → verify no ErrorBoundary → tap All/Not Printed/Printed chips → confirm no crash).
Consider adding an ESLint rule (e.g. `no-use-before-define` with variables:true) to catch TDZ hoisting bugs at lint time — this is the SECOND identical regression in F4.3.
critical_code_review_comments: shipments.tsx is 3424 lines — WAY over the 700-line guideline. Two ReferenceError regressions in a row on the same feature (F4.3) are a direct consequence of the file's size and mixed state/render/callback ordering. Strongly recommend splitting into: `shipments/index.tsx` (screen shell), `shipments/hooks.ts` (state + memos), `shipments/PrintStatusFilterRow.tsx`, `shipments/ShipmentCard.tsx`.

useState hooks for a single feature (F4.3) are currently scattered — `advancingId` at line 732, `pendingPrintConfirmId` at 737, `printFilter` at 740 — while their consumer (dateFilteredItems useMemo) is 360+ lines earlier at line 379. Group hooks by feature, then place ALL of them before the first useMemo that reads them.

The bug pattern shows `search_replace` is being used to insert large blocks in the middle of a 3.4k-line file; each edit risks either deleting a declaration or inserting a consumer above its producer. A targeted refactor to split the file will make future F4.x edits safe.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Shipments tab is entry-level broken. To reproduce: open http://localhost:3000, click 'I already have an account', log in as admin@test.com / Admin@12345, then click the Shipments tab in the bottom nav. Instantly renders the ErrorBoundary red 'The app hit an unexpected error' screen with `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'printFilter' before initialization`. Cause: TDZ — useMemo at line 379 reads printFilter (line 740). Fix: hoist the `printFilter` useState above the useMemo. After the fix, verify the three chips (All / Not Printed / Printed) render below the header and tapping between them does not crash. rca_of_issue: RCA — Temporal Dead Zone: `const [printFilter, setPrintFilter] = useState(...)` at line 740 is hoisted (as a JS `let`-binding) but not initialized until execution reaches that line. The `dateFilteredItems = useMemo(...)` at line 379 executes on the first render and reads `printFilter` at line 386, well BEFORE line 740. Result: ReferenceError on first render → ErrorBoundary. This is the second regression in Phase F4.3 caused by an F4.3 state hook being placed after code that consumes it — the first was `advancingId` (fixed by main agent by restoring the useState at line 732), the second is `printFilter` (still broken because it was only restored at line 740, still below its consumer). Reproduction: (1) run frontend on localhost:3000, (2) log in as admin, (3) tap Shipments tab, (4) observe red ErrorBoundary. Mitigation: move `printFilter` useState above line 379 (ideally group all F4.3 hooks together near the top of the component). Prevention: split shipments.tsx (3424 lines) and enable ESLint `no-use-before-define` with variables:true.
